brief.styleSuffix: Original video game instrumental score. Only musical instruments. No vocals, no singing, no speech, no choir, no humming, no vocal samples. Clear melodic phrases, restrained dynamics, spacious clean production, gentle high frequencies, controlled bass, seamless flowing arrangement.

tracks.title: A Small Light Between Stars
tracks.style: Warm adventurous fantasy strategy game courtyard music, 96 BPM, D major. Pizzicato strings, hand-played marimba, celesta, gentle orchestral woodwinds, brushed hand percussion and warm analog synth bass. Playful and welcoming, with an instantly memorable four-note rising motif. Small ensemble, delicate rather than bombastic.
tracks.arrangement:
[Instrumental introduction: celesta and pizzicato strings state a rising four-note melody]
[Instrumental A section: marimba joins the woodwind melody with light hand percussion]
[Instrumental B section: warm strings and a gentle countermelody]
[Instrumental reprise: return to the opening melody and a soft sustained instrumental ending]

tracks.title: Footprints on a New World
tracks.style: Curious planetary exploration instrumental, 84 BPM, G lydian. Soft kalimba, plucked acoustic strings, isolated piano notes, breath-free pure sine bells, gentle string harmonics, round electric bass and sparse wooden percussion. Wonder, discovery, open space and a touch of mystery. Light fantasy meets friendly science fiction. Plenty of silence between phrases.
tracks.arrangement:
[Instrumental opening: sparse kalimba and soft piano]
[Instrumental exploration: a wandering plucked-string melody with quiet wooden rhythm]
[Instrumental horizon: string harmonics and bell countermelody]
[Instrumental return: reprise the kalimba motif over a resolving bass line]

tracks.title: Hold the Worldheart
tracks.style: Energetic instrumental tower defense combat music, 120 BPM, E minor. Tight staccato strings, punchy toms, taiko accents, melodic brass instruments, rhythmic marimba and a crisp analog arpeggiator. Heroic, determined, playful and satisfying. Strong groove with space for weapon sound effects; no distorted wall of sound. A memorable rising heroic motif.
tracks.arrangement:
[Instrumental intro: tight tom groove and staccato strings]
[Instrumental battle A: heroic brass melody with marimba rhythm]
[Instrumental battle B: ascending analog arpeggios and answering strings]
[Instrumental reprise: full heroic motif, then a clean instrumental resolution]

tracks.title: The Breach Answers
tracks.style: Urgent instrumental fantasy science-fiction boss battle, 128 BPM, D minor. Low bowed strings, tightly gated analog bass, snare and deep tom polyrhythms, sharp brass stabs and bright plucked synth counterpoint. Menacing but adventurous. Clearly articulated musical instruments, controlled sub-bass, rhythmic tension without harsh high frequencies.
tracks.arrangement:
[Instrumental warning: low strings and a short drum pickup]
[Instrumental assault: driving bass pulse and brass response]
[Instrumental escalation: bright arpeggio above interlocking string rhythms]
[Instrumental resolve: return to the main rhythmic motif]

tracks.title: Another Dawn Defended
tracks.style: Joyful instrumental game victory celebration, 104 BPM, D major. Bright orchestral brass, nimble string runs, celesta, marimba, cymbal swells and cheerful hand percussion. Rewarding and warm, a small earned celebration after defending a planet. Short melodic phrases with a clear resolved ending.
tracks.arrangement:
[Instrumental fanfare: rising brass and sparkling celesta]
[Instrumental celebration: strings and marimba answer the fanfare]
[Instrumental ending: a bright major chord and ringing bells]

tracks.title: An Ember Remains
tracks.style: Gentle instrumental game defeat reflection, 72 BPM, B minor resolving toward D major. Felt piano, soft cello played with a bow, sparse celesta and warm synth pad made from pure instrumental tones. Bittersweet, encouraging, understated and calm. No dramatic impact, no percussion wall, no choir texture.
tracks.arrangement:
[Instrumental opening: soft felt piano and quiet cello]
[Instrumental reflection: celesta repeats a hopeful four-note motif]
[Instrumental ending: warm major harmony with a gentle sustained piano chord]
